q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an extension board?
title: Extension board carbon footprint per piece
short: Weigh the plastic body, brass contacts and copper cable per board and multiply by supplier figures. Add moulding, assembly and testing electricity, divide by boards passed, and report by number of sockets and cable length.
audience: Extension board and spike guard makers

p: Report per board with socket count and cable length, since the cable is often the heaviest metal part.

example.title: Worked example: extension board unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 14,200 / 100,000 = 0.142 kg CO2 per piece
Add plastic, brass and cable for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
